title: lastrea densiloba
intro: Lastrea densiloba, commonly known as the Rock Cap fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. It is known for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, due to its potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Lastrea densiloba include its ability to reduce pain and inflammation, and its potential to act as an antioxidant and a free radical scavenger. The bioactive constituents of Lastrea densiloba include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
